g2911009745554760959.text: Serious Parafolks are ambitious and goal-oriented.\n\nThey thrive the most when they are achieving great things.

g8666794897242028856.text: Grumpy Parafolks are short-tempered and get mad easily.\n\nThey thrive the most when they have a lot of things to grump about.

g2081948952068750564.text: Gloomy Parafolks get sad easily, but they choose to embrace it.\n\nThey thrive the most when they are sad.

g3633492287906250219.text: Energetic Parafolks are very active and often have an energy surplus that allows them to do more with their day.\n\nThey thrive the most when they can use this extra energy.

g8673500924326667059.text: Peaceful Parafolks are calm and prefer to focus on their inner peace.\n\nThey thrive the most when taking the time to reflect and putting their accumulated inner peace to good use.

g1681587064510321725.text: Sensitive Parafolks are empathic and feel their emotions more intensely.\n\nThey thrive the most when they can leverage their emotions to achieve their goals.

g5237154496884887069.text: Jester Parafolks are good at making fun of everything and are always full of surprises.\n\nThey thrive the most when they can make people laugh and follow their whimsy.

g487917317995391506.text: Samantha has worked her way to the absolute top! She prides herself on engaging her employees through team building activities and curating a positive workplace environment. g2568842644011077516.text: Tyrie is not only artistically brilliant, but also loves to share her gifts with her community, prioritizing values such as love, acceptance, equality, and sustainability. Through her art and music, she promotes individuality and freedom of expression. Her main goal is to fight for what's right, and to uplift positive voices in the community.

g2498111775082639899.text: Kareem loves all things cozy and comforting. He enjoys the simple things in life: rainy days, black coffee, and a good book. He spends his time escaping into stories, as the trials of day-to-day life are a little overwhelming for him at times. Maybe he'd like someone to share his stories with?

g6828366114912791564.text: Florence and Faye have been happily married for 30 years! They've been together through thick and thin, supporting each other and holding hands through the best and worst of times. Both now retired, Florence can focus on her garden, and Faye can relax and listen to her favorite vinyl records. Every morning, they enjoy reminiscing about beautiful memories created over a lifetime. They both relish every single day knowing soulmates exist, waiting for the next life where they'll be sure to find each other again.

g8712207051291003306.text: The Preston-Beaumonts are the perfect family... or at least they seem to be. Peeking behind the white picket fence will reveal Pauline's rigidity, Gerard's struggle with his work-life balance, and Zoe trying her best to figure herself out alongside her baby brother Adrien.

g2315985330573019779.text: If charisma had a name, it'd be Lian Reed! He knows exactly how to charm and schmooze his way into getting what he wants. It's essentially his greatest quality, but maybe it's even... his greatest flaw?

g5399648846515699458.text: Celebrating something? You absolutely want to invite Rebecca, Bianca, and Monica! They're not only the life of the party, they ARE the party. However, life has a way of reminding us all of a simple fact: we all have to grow up at some point. Will these three friends be able to handle the ups and downs of careers, bills, and maybe even family life, all while continuing to uphold their status as partying legends?

g909740289237761521.text: Solene loves cupcakes, romance movies, and frolicking through fields in her best sundress. Kian loves spicy chicken wings, restoring his old motorcycle, and moshing at heavy metal concerts. Together? Well, it turns out that cute pink dresses look GREAT in a mosh pit, as does black icing on cupcakes. What more can these two opposites learn from each other?

g2423498707472218667.text: In Paralives, you can pick a <link=0>Storyteller</link> to accompany your Parafolks while they live their <link=1>stories</link>. Each Storyteller affects gameplay elements in different ways.

g537902857560112000.text: When creating a household in the Paramaker, different aspects of each Parafolk's <link=0>personality</link> can be selected. Their personality impacts their <link=1>emotions</link>, <link=2>wants</link>, <link=3>needs</link>, <link=4>life goals</link>, and <link=5>Together Cards</link>.

g886284376468065761.text: Parafolks gain personality points by completing <link=0>wants</link> and <link=1>life goals</link>. When they have enough points, their personality levels up, allowing you to upgrade an aspect of it.

g6341040758997859262.text: After <link=0>creating some Parafolks</link> and <link=1>building their house</link>, Live Mode is where the life simulation takes place, allowing you to manage and watch your Parafolks as their lives unfold.

g3483296561551828198.text: Parafolks have needs that must be taken care of. If neglected, they'll be in a bad mood, which affects their <link=0>job performance</link>, <link=1>Together Cards</link>, and <link=2>skill</link> learning speed.

g2597268287656006235.text: To relieve their Hunger need, Parafolks can use the fridge to eat snacks or cook recipes.

g1252342916850907971.text: More recipes can be learned on the computer, through <link=0>Together Cards</link>, or by leveling up the cooking skill. Higher-level recipes have a higher chance of failing and producing spoiled food.

g7273000680079274418.text: While away <link=0>at work or at school</link>, a Para's Hunger need will automatically be relieved during lunch hours.

g8875109567927094254.text: Parafolks can die if their Hunger bar is empty for too long.

g5595782855085972816.text: To relieve their Bathroom need, Parafolks can use the toilet. While away <link=0>at work or at school</link>, the need will automatically be relieved.

g7806134398683385995.text: To relieve the Sleep need, Parafolks can use a bed to sleep. Going to sleep resets whatever <link=0>wants</link> the Parafolk had before sleeping.

g2292190294937828588.text: Parafolks can die if their Sleep need is empty for too long.

g1587547603792567768.text: To relieve their Hygiene need, Parafolks can shower or bathe. Washing their hands or brushing their teeth will also relieve the need by a small amount.

g4514214347410703068.text: Parafolks go through different emotions based on their successes, their failures, and how their day unfolds in general.

g1347038863945846939.text: Each emotion has a number indicating the current strength of said emotion. Hovering your mouse over an emotion shows the emotional reasons why the Para has the emotion, as well as how much time it will take for those emotional reasons to no longer influence it.

g7420546819708385234.text: Emotions can give bonuses to <link=0>job performance</link> and <link=1>skill</link> learning speed, as well as unlock <link=2>Together Cards</link>. Some <link=3>personality traits</link> also leverage certain emotions to get even more bonuses from them. For instance, Overjoyed Parafolks learn skills faster when happy, while Gloomy Parafolks learn skills faster when sad.

g8578814609891041567.text: Wants are short-term objectives that Parafolks can have. Parafolks can get new wants in reaction to various <link=0>emotions</link> they have.

g7034990198490505726.text: Click on the relevant emotion to select a new want.

g7395696075601005487.text: Wants always reset when going to sleep, but one of them can be pinned and saved for the next day:

g8740955923855271311.text: One want can be pinned at a time, and wants can also be deleted if you wish to make room for new ones.

g588164132771588738.text: Completing a want gives your Parafolks personality experience points, which can be used <link=0>to upgrade their personalities</link>.

g7359858453159318471.text: While <link=0>wants</link> are short-term objectives, Parafolks can also obtain long-term goals.

g7224384495155139942.text: To see a given Parafolk's list of goals, open the Goal panel.

g6100793144936616530.text: A goal can be tracked so that it always remains visible while playing in Live Mode. Goals can also be removed if you no longer want to complete them.

g6614321707362934918.text: Life goals are long-term objectives that Parafolks can have.

g7703339183581219213.text: New life goals can be randomly obtained from time to time through <link=0>Story Cards</link>.

g7777715456527354472.text: Your Parafolk's <link=0>personality</link> and previously completed life goals affect what future life goals will be offered.

g8841015525176559661.text: Completing a life goal gives personality points, which can be used to <link=0>upgrade a Parafolk's personality</link>.

g1506644750544130352.text: Requests are long-term objectives given by Townies. Townies have new requests every day.

g4177225198355318415.text: Requests can be obtained by checking the town's request boards or by talking to a Townie who has a “!” above their head.

g4039699613255616050.text: Once you've completed a request, you can claim your reward by using the appropriate <link=0>Together Card</link> with the Townie who made the request.

g5668255528819717776.text: Parafolks grow old and eventually pass away. Make the most of their time and prepare for the next generation.

g3695474042567620167.text: Their current life stage and the time remaining before the next one can be seen in the Profile panel.

g1893422488887467591.text: Customize your <link=0>Storyteller</link> to disable aging or change the duration of life stages.

g313821347465563769.text: Groups of Parafolks can be formed in many ways, listed below. When in a group, you can then pick <link=0>Together Cards</link> to make the conversation evolve.

g402639286135625643.text: Clicking on a Parafolk and selecting the “Talk” interaction will automatically form a group.

g1553659474382563970.text: To do something as a group, first draw a selection rectangle by clicking the left mouse button and dragging the cursor to select all Parafolks in a given zone.

g134900233083136746.text: Alternatively, hold the Shift key and then left-click Parafolks in the interface to select them and form a group. Parafolks in the world can be right-clicked to be selected, and holding the Shift key will allow you to select multiple Parafolks.

g3582250897113939418.text: While a group is formed, interactions are marked as such in the interaction queue. As long as you stay in the group, interactions will be synced and done by the whole group.

g6691970976978532805.text: To get a Para to leave a group, cancel their current group interaction or click the “Leave” button in the mouseover panel.

g2572941736390588176.text: Parafolks will sometimes leave a group autonomously. This can happen if the Para needs to go to work, is very bored, too hungry, etc.

g4349523444748406359.text: While in a group, Parafolks can talk together or do any interactions they can do solo, such as taking care of their needs, working on their skills, and so on.

g7022178952132092738.text: As long as Parafolks stay in a group, their Together Bar will increase, no matter what they do together. When the bar is filled, the “!” button can be clicked to select a new Together Card.

g186537340843117735.text: Together Cards let you select a development for the conversation that a group of Paras is having.

g1170896696964058070.text: Parafolks can explore different ways to develop their relationships, whether that includes making jokes, being mean, flirting, and more.

g5516021569184486972.text: Every card will change the emotions of each Parafolk differently, which can influence the next Together Cards offered once the Together Bar is filled up again.

g2232434575192977719.text: When in a group, depending on the emotions of the individual Parafolks, the <link=0>Storyteller</link> will sometimes offer a special <link=1>Together Card</link> that makes their relationship evolve through a new Relationship Label.

g5516063599539134567.text: Because these Parafolks made jokes together and have the Amused emotion, the <link=0>Storyteller</link> offers the opportunity for them to become friends.

g2005836252052951278.text: Unlocking Relationship Labels and leveling them up will unlock new interactions and <link=0>Together Cards</link> for when those Parafolks spend time together.

g757051282047354039.text: Working is the most common way for Parafolks to earn money. When a Para has a job, they automatically commute to and from work based on their job's schedule. Parafolks cannot be controlled while they are at work.

g4780578127492818359.text: To find work, Parafolks can use the computer, the phone, or find job posters at workplaces around town.

g7564423056030384788.text: Job positions have different requirements, expressed in the form of points. Mouse over a position to see where your Parafolk stands and what they need to improve to be able to get a specific job.

g591408696826854837.text: This Parafolk needs to increase their skills in cooking or gain more work experience in the field to be able to get this position.

g8751825585532555332.text: After each day of work, your Parafolk will earn their salary and have the chance to get a job upgrade point. The likelihood of this happening is equal to the percentage value indicated by the job performance meter.

g3674964163403914342.text: Job performance can be improved by going to work with positive <link=0>emotions</link> and by continuing to work on the skills required for the job.

g2797488712253784959.text: You can spend upgrade points to increase your Parafolk's rank in their job, giving them a small boost in salary, or to unlock unique perks.

g3770913732256281454.text: A Parafolk can only have a certain number of perks at a time, meaning that a previous perk may need to be removed to make room for a new, better one.

g844182616663326132.text: Parafolks can have more than one job as long as their schedules don't conflict. When accepting a new job, you can choose the job's schedule. Different jobs have different days and hours offered.

g8034749580897481604.text: To change the schedule of an existing job, click the “Change Schedule” button at the bottom of the occupation panel.

g3527079465542046706.text: To quit a job, click the “Quit Job” button at the bottom of the occupation panel.

g2304568984894746492.text: Parafolks in the child and pre-teen life stages are automatically enrolled in elementary school, while those in the teen life stage are in high school. Students will automatically go to school Monday through Friday. They cannot be controlled when at school.

g3261980253847872271.text: Like jobs, Parafolks attending school can unlock occupation perks, and they can also improve their grades in school subjects. This is done through upgrade points earned at the end of each school day.

g4529659989398360945.text: The likelihood of getting an upgrade point each day is equal to the percentage value indicated by the school performance meter. Parafolks heading to school with positive <link=0>emotions</link> will do better in school.

g1355300876855596234.text: After a school day, Parafolks will sometimes have homework to do.

g8189055609290571334.text: A computer can be used to complete homework, which will improve the grade of the corresponding school subject.

g5471303151459035602.text: Baby and toddler Parafolks automatically go to daycare when no teen-or-older Parafolks are with them at home. When an older Para does come back, babies and toddlers will automatically come back from daycare.

g6131304367644933401.text: Weekly <link=0>bank statements</link> will list daycare costs, which will be higher the more time they spend there.

g7070079414965970451.text: By working on their skills, Parafolks can progress and level them up, unlocking new interactions and helping them perform better at <link=0>work</link>.

g4932999930521664882.text: Mouse over a skill in progress to see how fast your Parafolk is currently learning. This speed will change depending on your Para's <link=0>emotions</link>, <link=1>personality traits</link>, and more.

g6532363968723814005.text: Skills fall under general skills that are called knowledge skills.

g932074709016146979.text: For example, working on the guitar skill will also slowly make your Para progress in the music knowledge skill. The Para will be able to learn other instruments like the piano faster because of their music knowledge.

g1645554295485489130.text: Knowledge skills can also be learned directly through the computer.

g665263244875575713.text: Every Monday, Parafolks receive their household's bank statement through the mail panel.

g3912330537125019330.text: Each bank statement lists electricity and water usage costs. Parafolks can also receive financial assistance, such as a family benefit for having children and paid work expenses.

g5542292416499407756.text: Not paying bills will have your electricity and water services cut off until you settle all accounts.
